visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair tied in a bun, wearing a white textured fringed jacket over a sparkling gold sequin dress and pearl necklaces, stands on an urban street at night. She speaks enthusiastically to the camera, smiling broadly with her hands gesturing occasionally. (2) She turns and walks away from the camera, revealing the back of her outfit and a tan shoulder bag, then quickly turns back to continue her animated conversation. Street lights and parked cars are visible in the background. (3) As she mentions specific celebrities, small square inset images appear on the screen showing portraits of male actors and singers. She gestures toward the camera with high energy. (4) She mimics a rapid throwing motion with her right hand, laughing as she describes a scene. Two larger video insets appear at the bottom: one shows a man on stage throwing bills, and the other shows a crowded festive event. (5) She faces the camera again, expressing excitement with wide eyes and frequent hand movements. The lighting is warm from street lamps, highlighting her expressions. (6) She turns and walks further away into the dimly lit street while looking back over her shoulder with a final cheerful smile. (7) The scene shifts to a brightly lit stage with an 'ANNUAL PARTY' backdrop. A man in a hot pink jacket and black trousers performs with a microphone, surrounded by professional cameras and dancers.
